features.clause_structure: Moves from a typed input through a named transformation to an explicit output, interpretation, or next-section handoff.
features.quantitative_role: Preserves variables, units, life stage, time basis, ecosystem, parameter setting, and downstream consumer when the source move is quantitative.
features.transition: Uses base-model pivots, equation references, scenario headings, figure comparisons, and body-to-letter compression to keep the analytical ladder visible.
